tier2.summary:
INCOMPLETE
  ✗ Implement and test a re-runnable boardctl status normalization sweep with dry-run and apply semantics for one board without guessing unknown statuses; add a reported-vs-verified completion marker and expose its counts on board-report/v1; document alias warning policy; include traceability links to row, source, tests, evidence, and commit.: Most sub-parts PASS, but the traceability clause is entirely missing. PASSING: (a) sweep — cmd/boardctl/statusnormalize.go cmdNormalizeStatuses implements `normalize-statuses [--apply] [--dry-run] [--json] [-C dir]`, rejects positional args, resolves exactly one board via openBoard(dir); internal/board/statusnormalize.go NormalizeStatuses(apply) runs under withWriteLock and does one guarded atomicRewrite, leaving untouched lines byte-identical. (b) no guessing — unknown statuses go to Refused/UnknownCount and missing to MissingCount (internal/board/statusnormalize.go), never coerced; tests internal/board/statusnormalize_test.go TestNormalizeStatusesDryRunPreservesBytesAndRefusesUnknown + TestNormalizeStatusesApplyIsAtomicAndIdempotent, and cmd/boardctl/statusnormalize_test.go CLI dry-run/apply/help tests. (c) marker — internal/render/derive.go:147-151 adds reported_complete_count/verified_complete_count/unverified_complete_count, computed at :236-242 via board.RowEvidenceRunIDs; internal/render/bt081_report_test.go asserts the JSON island keys (3/2/1) and the rendered cmd/boardctl/board-report.html payload carries all three keys. (d) policy docs — docs/operations.md §1b, docs/specs/board-analytics-report.md §3.9a, skills/boardctl-usage/SKILL.md:197-206. (e) tests run fresh: `go build ./...` exit 0; `go test -count=1 ./...` → all packages ok (cmd/boardctl 6.182s, internal/board 2.692s, internal/render 0.025s). FAILING — traceability links to row/source/tests/evidence/commit: `grep -c "ch:trace row=BT-81" .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` returns 0 and `grep -rn "BT-81" docs/ skills/` returns 0 hits (only an unrelated "BT-081" code comment at skills/boardctl-usage/SKILL.md:197). The BT-81 board row (.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl:208) is untouched by commits cd2eebf/e81a8c8 — status still "pending", commit_hash/worker_summary/foreman_note all null, no evidence path, no ch:trace foreman_note (contrast the BT-82 row, which carries `ch:trace row=BT-82 ... test=... evidence=.gitreins/history/.../verdict.json ... commit=8a21b1d`). No evidence artifact exists for these commits (no .gitreins/history entry/verdict.json), and the commit is referenced only in the commit message ("Addresses BT-81"), not linked from the row or docs. Additionally an unrelated generated file cmd/boardctl/board-report.html (rendered_at timestamp churn) is left uncommitted in the working tree.
The normalization sweep, fail-closed unknown handling, reported-vs-verified counts on board-report/v1, and alias-warning policy docs are implemented and the full `go test -count=1 ./...` suite passes, but the required traceability links (ch:trace row=BT-81, row commit_hash/evidence, evidence artifact) are absent, so the criterion is not fully met.
